Api.//: Absolute base URL of the Crawldad API the portal calls through Crawldad.Client. Dev default is the API's local http profile; override per environment (e.g. Crawldad__Api__BaseUrl).

ConnectionStrings.//: Same shared devcontainer Postgres the API uses (throwaway dev credential); the portal isolates itself in the "portal" schema. Override with the ConnectionStrings__marten env var. Never commit real secrets.
